hero.title1: Know exactly where your money goes
hero.subtitle: A personal finance tracker for income, expenses, gold, and gifts — with USD, JOD, and EGP always kept separate, never converted.

multiCurrency.title: Multi-currency accounts
multiCurrency.description: Track USD, JOD, and EGP separately across as many banks, wallets, and cash pockets as you need. Nothing is ever converted or combined.

expenses.title: Expenses by category & account
expenses.description: Log spending against the account it came from, with default and custom categories, so you always know what it was for and where it went.

income.title: Income you confirm
income.description: Recurring income is only counted once you confirm it arrived, so your balances always reflect reality — not just a schedule.

goldGifts.title: Gold & gifts
goldGifts.description: Keep tabs on gold holdings by karat, and one-off gifts you've given or received, alongside your everyday accounts.

stats.title: Monthly statistics
stats.description: See spending by category and balance distribution by institution, broken out per currency with clear, simple charts.

private.title: Private by default
private.description: Every account is fully isolated. Your data is yours alone, even when friends join and create their own accounts.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noExpenses: No expenses recorded for this month yet.
dashboard.pendingReminder: Your {name} was expected on {date} — not yet confirmed.

currencySettings.title: Currency Settings
currencySettings.description: Choose which currencies you want to use. Amounts are never converted between currencies — each is tracked and displayed separately.
